'''A-IDO translator droids''' were a model of [[Translator droid/Legends|translator droid]] in use in [[3643 BBY]]. Known as "coneheads," they were employed in [[Tassaa Bareesh]]'s [[Tassaa Bareesh's palace|palace]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].
